QuestInfo.name: Farewell For Now
QuestInfo.0: The Handsome Monk worked together with the town's private investigators to clear out the rest of the Monster Rat's mojo dolls, and the town finally knew some measure of peace.
QuestInfo.1: You decided to see if anyone in town has heard of any interesting rumors from afar. Doing that should also give you a chance to say goodbye to your friends and acquaintances too, since it may be a while before you have a chance to return here.
QuestInfo.2: You finished gathering information and saying your goodbyes. Your next destination is a place called Maple World, located in an entirely different dimension, so they say.
